title: Art. 3.9.3 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 3 - Entry and Departure of Persons and Their Baggage, C. Security of travel documents, 3.9.3
content: Recommended Practice. Contracting States implementing checks on eMRTDs at border controls should join the ICAO PKD and use the information available from the PKD to validate eMRTDs at border controls.
